name: gmail-mcp
description: MCP server connecting Claude Desktop to Gmail via OAuth — search, read, send, reply, manage labels, drafts, and attachments.
instructions: Install: 1) Download credentials.json from Google Cloud Console (see docs/google-cloud-setup.md), 2) Run 'pip install -e .' from the project root, 3) Run 'gmail-mcp' (or 'python -m gmail_mcp') once to authenticate, 4) Register with Claude Desktop via 'mcp install src/gmail_mcp/server.py --name gmail-mcp'.
